# bdk CLI - every command of the `bdk` command line

::: v-pre

The plugin ships the `bdk` command line; its skills run it. Each block is what the command prints with `--help`.

```text
Usage: bdk <group> [<verb>] [arguments] [flags]

Command groups:
  check     Run the project's test, lint and build commands
  config    Show, check and set the BDK configuration
  findings  Record findings, levels and decisions of a review round; list them folded; write the report
  git       Review scope and reviewer groups of a branch
  hooks     Hook commands of the bdk plugin (SessionStart, PreToolUse)
  openspec  The BDK OpenSpec schema in a project
  plan      Check the plan parts of a Change
  rules     The rules a role reads for its stage and files
  run       State of an autopilot run

Flags:
  --help, -h  Show help
  --version   Print the bdk version
  --json      Print the result as one JSON document

Run bdk <group> --help for the commands of a group.
```

## `bdk check` {#check}

```text
Usage: bdk check <verb> [arguments] [flags]

Run the project's test, lint and build commands

Commands:
  run  Run the configured test, lint and build commands and write checks/<id>.json

Flags:
  --help, -h  Show help
  --version   Print the bdk version
  --json      Print the result as one JSON document

Run bdk check <verb> --help for the arguments and flags of a command.
```

### `bdk check run` {#check-run}

```text
Usage: bdk check run <run-dir> <id> [flags]

Run the configured test, lint and build commands and write checks/<id>.json

Arguments:
  <run-dir>  The Change's run directory, such as .bdk/runs/<change>; must exist
  <id>       Kebab-case name of the result, such as a part id or round-2

Flags:
  --scope <value>  A file to check, relative to the project root; runs the scoped variants (repeatable)
  --kind <value>   Only this kind: test, lint or build; all three when absent (repeatable)
  --round <value>  Append red checks as findings to review/round-<n>/findings.jsonl
  --help, -h       Show help
  --version        Print the bdk version
  --json           Print the result as one JSON document

Exit codes:
  0  success
  1  a check is red (failed or timed out); the result is printed
  2  usage error
  3  environment error
  4  internal error
```

## `bdk findings` {#findings}

```text
Usage: bdk findings <verb> [arguments] [flags]

Record findings, levels and decisions of a review round; list them folded; write the report

Commands:
  add     Append a finding and print its id (the same id for a duplicate)
  level   Append the level of a finding; the latest level counts
  decide  Append the decision on a finding; the latest decision counts
  list    Fold the log: findings with their latest level and decision, and counts
  report  Write the folded log as report.md next to it, the round report

Flags:
  --help, -h  Show help
  --version   Print the bdk version
  --json      Print the result as one JSON document

Run bdk findings <verb> --help for the arguments and flags of a command.
```

### `bdk findings add` {#findings-add}

```text
Usage: bdk findings add <log> [flags]

Append a finding and print its id (the same id for a duplicate)

Arguments:
  <log>  The findings log, e.g. .bdk/runs/<change>/review/round-<N>/findings.jsonl

Flags:
  --source <value>    Who reports it, e.g. review-group (required)
  --summary <value>   What is wrong, in one line (required)
  --file <value>      The file it is in
  --line <value>      The line in --file, a positive integer
  --rule <value>      The rule or check it breaks; part of the dedupe key
  --evidence <value>  What shows it: output, a quote, steps
  --help, -h          Show help
  --version           Print the bdk version
  --json              Print the result as one JSON document

Exit codes:
  0  success
  2  usage error
  3  environment error
  4  internal error
```

### `bdk findings level` {#findings-level}

```text
Usage: bdk findings level <log> <id> <level> [flags]

Append the level of a finding; the latest level counts

Arguments:
  <log>    The findings log, e.g. .bdk/runs/<change>/review/round-<N>/findings.jsonl
  <id>     The finding id, as add printed it
  <level>  blocker, should-fix, nice-to-have, not-a-problem

Flags:
  --reason <value>  Why this level, in one line
  --help, -h        Show help
  --version         Print the bdk version
  --json            Print the result as one JSON document

Exit codes:
  0  success
  2  usage error
  3  environment error
  4  internal error
```

### `bdk findings decide` {#findings-decide}

```text
Usage: bdk findings decide <log> <id> <decision> [flags]

Append the decision on a finding; the latest decision counts

Arguments:
  <log>       The findings log, e.g. .bdk/runs/<change>/review/round-<N>/findings.jsonl
  <id>        The finding id, as add printed it
  <decision>  fix, accept, defer

Flags:
  --issue <value>   The issue that tracks it; defer only, optional
  --reason <value>  Why this decision, in one line
  --help, -h        Show help
  --version         Print the bdk version
  --json            Print the result as one JSON document

Exit codes:
  0  success
  2  usage error
  3  environment error
  4  internal error
```

### `bdk findings list` {#findings-list}

```text
Usage: bdk findings list <log> [flags]

Fold the log: findings with their latest level and decision, and counts

Arguments:
  <log>  The findings log, e.g. .bdk/runs/<change>/review/round-<N>/findings.jsonl

Flags:
  --level <value>     List only this level: blocker, should-fix, nice-to-have, not-a-problem, unleveled
  --decision <value>  List only this decision: fix, accept, defer, undecided; fix is what to fix
  --help, -h          Show help
  --version           Print the bdk version
  --json              Print the result as one JSON document

Exit codes:
  0  success
  2  usage error
  3  environment error
  4  internal error
```

### `bdk findings report` {#findings-report}

```text
Usage: bdk findings report <log> [flags]

Write the folded log as report.md next to it, the round report

Arguments:
  <log>  The findings log, e.g. .bdk/runs/<change>/review/round-<N>/findings.jsonl
```

## `bdk git` {#git}

```text
Usage: bdk git <verb> [arguments] [flags]

Review scope and reviewer groups of a branch

Commands:
  scope   The range and the changed files a review round covers
  groups  The scope of a review round split into reviewer groups

Flags:
  --help, -h  Show help
  --version   Print the bdk version
  --json      Print the result as one JSON document

Run bdk git <verb> --help for the arguments and flags of a command.
```

### `bdk git scope` {#git-scope}

```text
Usage: bdk git scope <base> [flags]

The range and the changed files a review round covers

Arguments:
  <base>  The branch the work merges into; the first round starts at its merge base

Flags:
  --rounds <value>  The run's review/ directory; start after the last round-<N>/ holding report.md and groups.json
  --help, -h        Show help
  --version         Print the bdk version
  --json            Print the result as one JSON document

Exit codes:
  0  success
  2  usage error
  3  environment error
  4  internal error
```

### `bdk git groups` {#git-groups}

```text
Usage: bdk git groups <base> [flags]

The scope of a review round split into reviewer groups

Arguments:
  <base>  The branch the work merges into; the first round starts at its merge base

Flags:
  --rounds <value>     The run's review/ directory; start after the last round-<N>/ holding report.md and groups.json
  --plan <value>       The Change's plan/parts/ directory; group by part instead of by module
  --max-files <value>  The file target of a group (default 30); a third above it is tolerated
  --record <value>     Also write the result to <dir>/groups.json, the record later rounds start from
  --help, -h           Show help
  --version            Print the bdk version
  --json               Print the result as one JSON document

Exit codes:
  0  success
  2  usage error
  3  environment error
  4  internal error
```
